responsibility: Declares the data structures and APIs for tree SSA value numbering. It defines the vn_nary_op, vn_phi, vn_reference, constant, and SSA-lattice records plus value-id utilities, and exposes lookup/insert/simplification interfaces, RPO-VN and elimination entry points, expression equality helpers, and valueization hooks consumed by PRE, FRE, jump threading, and other optimizers.
same_name_distinction: This header is the interface and type-definition side of tree SSA value numbering, declaring vn_nary_op/vn_phi/vn_reference records, VN lattice/access helpers, and entry points like do_rpo_vn. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-sccvn.cc, it does not implement the SCC/RPO algorithms, elimination, or the FRE pass logic.
